business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fabless Integrated Circuit Architecture and IP Core Licensing

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Spain (national unitary jurisdiction; Autonomous Communities do not hold company-law or direct-tax sub-divergence material to a Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Spain-China Bilateral Investment Treaty for the Promotion and Reciprocal Protection of Investments (signed 14 February 2005; in force 1 July 2008) — principal BIT protection for non-resident Chinese/Pan-Asian shareholders in a fabless semiconductor design and IP-licensing vehicle

Spain-China Double Taxation Agreement (signed 22 February 1990; in force 19 May 1992) — governs withholding taxes on cross-border royalties from ISIC 2610 IP-core licensing and permanent-establishment thresholds for engineering activity
Spain-United States Income Tax Treaty (in force 1991, as amended by the 2013 Protocol effective 2014) — relevant where US fabless customers or US-dollar SWIFT payment rails are used
Spain-Chile Double Taxation Agreement and Spain-Chile Bilateral Investment Treaty — anchoring the stated Latin-America commercial bridge strategy and local distribution/licensing hub
EU-Chile Advanced Framework Agreement (investment protection title; provisionally applied since 1 February 2024) — institutional basis for the Latin-American trade corridor

Spain maintains a general active network of over 100 double taxation agreements and approximately 80 bilateral investment treaties; the instruments above are the most directly applicable to the ES_SL fabless IP-licensing structure.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Consolidated Text of the Capital Companies Act (Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio), Articles 20-22 bis, 28, 58-64 and 124-128; Commercial Registry Regulations (Real Decreto 1784/1996), Articles 6, 58 and 362.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the registered office under the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública (Ministry of Justice)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura de constitución (notarial public deed) followed by application for inscription in the Registro Mercantil
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum subscribed and fully paid-up share capital is EUR 3,000 for a Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada; the entire capital must be subscribed and paid up on incorporation and deposited in a Spanish bank account in the company's name, with the bank deposit certificate attached to the public deed. No separate escrow or blocked capital account is required under Spanish law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF THE INCORPORATING SHAREHOLDER. That the entire initial share capital set forth in the deed is hereby confirmed as subscribed and fully paid in by the founding shareholder, the funds having been deposited in a Spanish bank account. That the registered office of the company shall be established at [address], Madrid, Spain, and all legal and administrative correspondence shall be directed there. That [Name] is appointed sole administrator/managing director, and [Name, if any] is appointed secretary, each accepting office. The directors are installed with full management powers, to execute all filings, registrations, and permits necessary to operate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an electronic application through the Registro Mercantil Central online system or via a notary requesting a negative denomination certificate for the proposed company name. Provide at least three alternative names to reduce rejection risk. The certificate is valid for three months and may be renewed once for a further three months before deed execution.
required_dossiers: Completed name reservation request form
Founder's NIE or passport copy
Applicant's tax identification document (if acting for legal entity)
Administrative fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is refused for identical similarity, resubmit immediately with the subsequent alternative. If the certificate expires, apply once for renewal before the notarial deed is executed; if exhaustion of alternatives occurs, select a new distinctive denomination.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution subject to Bank of Spain supervision
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account in the name of the future company and deposit the minimum capital of EUR 3,000 or such higher amount as set in the bylaws. Request a bank deposit certificate stating that the funds are blocked for the future company and available exclusively for incorporation. The certificate must be dated no earlier than the 15 days preceding deed execution.
required_dossiers: Company name certificate from the Registro Mercantil Central
Draft articles of association
Founder's passport or NIE
Proof of registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires additional compliance documentation, present the drafted bylaws and tax identification of the founding shareholder. If the certificate is delayed, obtain a provisional bank statement and ask the notary for a supplementary capital deposit confirmation before deed signing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarial Execution of Escritura de Constitución
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notario Público in Spain (General Council of the Spanish Notariat)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear before the chosen notary with the name certificate, bank deposit certificate, approved bylaws and identification documents. Execute the incorporation deed containing the shareholders, share capital, registered office, corporate object encompassing fabless integrated circuit design and IP licensing, administration structure, and acceptance of appointments. The notary will collect the statutory fee and later submit the deed to the Mercantile Registry.
required_dossiers: Negative name certificate
Bank deposit certificate
Bylaws signed by all founders
Passports or NIEs of all founding shareholders
Tax identification and incorporation documents for corporate founders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies a legal defect in the bylaws or capital provisions, correct the clauses by a new instrument or by signing a private addendum incorporated into the deed file. If the capital certificate has lapsed, obtain an updated deposit certificate before re-execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for Provisional Tax Identification Number (NIF)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) — Oficina de Gestión Tributaria
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After execution of the public deed and before final registry inscription, file Form 036 (or 037 for simplified registration) at the competent AEAT tax office requesting the provisional CIF/NIF. Attach the first copy or notarial excerpt of the deed and proof of the legal representative's appointment. The provisional NIF enables bank account activation and subsequent licensing applications.
required_dossiers: Form 036/037 signed by the legal representative
Authorized copy of the notarial incorporation deed
DNI, NIE or passport of the legal representative
Proof of the registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT queries the representative's capacity or the deed's legalization, provide the original or a digitally signed copy of the deed and, if necessary, file a correction form. If a compliance inspection is opened, present the company's full constitutional file to demonstrate legitimate incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription in the Provincial Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary or legal representative must file the first copy of the incorporation deed with the Provincial Mercantile Registry within 20 business days of execution. Include Form 600 evidencing payment or exemption from the Stamp Duty (Actos Jurídicos Documentados) where applicable. Submit a signed application for registration referencing the provisional NIF. The registry will qualify the documents and issue the final inscription.
required_dossiers: First copy of the public deed of incorporation
Form 600 and bank proof of payment or exemption evidence
Signed application for registry inscription
Copy of provisional NIF
Original power of attorney if filing by legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a grounding for refusal, cure the defect within the statutory period by executing a corrective notarial instrument or by supplying the missing document. If the defect relates to the corporate purpose or articles, apply for a new public deed amending the bylaws and resubmit to the same registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive NIF Collection and Municipal Activity Licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) and the competent Ayuntamiento
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon issuance of the Mercantile Registry certificate, submit an updated Form 036 to AEAT to obtain the definitive CIF/NIF. At the municipal level, file a declaration of commencement of activity (declaración responsable) or apply for an opening license for a technology/office use, because the entity is a fabless semiconductor design center. The municipal application triggers inspection of the premises for fire safety, electrical installation and occupational health compliance.
required_dossiers: Mercantile Registry certificate of incorporation
Form 036/037 for definitive CIF application
Lease or title of the registered office and operating premises
Occupational risk prevention plan
Fire safety compliance documentation and emergency plan
Project and technical report for municipal activity license
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Ayuntamiento requires a full activity license (licencia de actividad) instead of a simple declaration, submit a technical project completed by a competent architect and await the inspection. If the definitive CIF is delayed, use the provisional NIF for contracts while retaining proof of registry registration, and accompany with a written extension request at AEAT.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Dirección General de Industria y de la Pequeña y Mediana Empresa (Spanish Ministry of Industry, Trade and Tourism) in coordination with the municipal activity licensing department of the relevant Ayuntamiento
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Declaración responsable de inicio de actividad and, where applicable, municipal licencia de apertura for an office-based fabless semiconductor design center; no separate industrial manufacturing permit is required for a fabless model.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico and the corresponding regional environmental authority
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — fabless semiconductor design operations do not constitute an industrial plant under Law 21/2013 on Environmental Assessment; no full EIA or simplified environmental registration is mandated.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater or VOC discharge is generated by a design office; general municipal waste and water disposal ordinances apply, with additional obligations under Ley 7/2022 on waste and contamination for prevention, reuse and recycling of materials introduced into the Spanish supply chain.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification must be issued by the competent local fire prevention service following inspection of the office premises; structural load inspection is necessary for any non-standard technical rooms; occupational clearance is required under Law 31/1995 on Occupational Risk Prevention and its implementing regulations on workplace conditions, signage, emergency plans and medical surveillance.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain operates a fully liberalized foreign exchange regime as a Eurozone and EU member. Current account transactions including service exports and profit remittances are freely convertible. Capital account transactions for EU residents face no prior restrictions; non-resident equity investments require only post-transaction reporting to Banco de España. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are permitted following corporate tax compliance, beneficial ownership verification and AML screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Mandatory surrender regime for export proceeds abolished in 2012. For goods exports no conversion or surrender is required. For services exports such as fabless semiconductor IP licensing, funds must be repatriated to Spain within 10 business days via bank transfer. Required documentation includes commercial invoices, service contracts and proof of delivery. Non-repatriation may trigger tax authority audits or penalties.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High viability for Spanish-regulated electronic money institutions such as N26 or local EMIs, subject to Banco de España licensing. Legal constraints include minimum capital requirements, strict KYC/AML obligations and restrictions on offshore activities.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote digital onboarding and KYC via certified electronic signatures and video interviews is permitted for Spanish SL entities. Physical presence of directors is not mandatory for standard account opening but may be required for high-value transactions or initial setup; video verification suffices for most cases.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Extracts from the Registro Mercantil confirming UBOs, notarized ownership structures, and declarations of tax residency for all shareholders

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Classification of IP licensing revenues as export services
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed service contracts, performance certificates, bank transfer records proving repatriation, and transfer pricing studies if applicable

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds for capital injections
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Foreign investor affidavits, proof of legitimate business purpose, and compliance with Spanish foreign investment notifications under Law 19/2003

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital from foreign investors or group entities is routed via SWIFT MT103 wires in EUR. Purpose codes include 'CAP' for capital contributions or 'EQTY' for equity. Verification protocols require board resolutions, source-of-funds letters, and matching of investor tax IDs. All transactions undergo full AML screening and reporting to Banco de España if thresholds met.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for trade settlements use SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'SERV' for service exports or 'PAY' for payments. Commercial Letters of Credit (LCs) are available through correspondent banks for international trade finance. For fabless semiconductor IP licensing, payments to suppliers or affiliates are cleared via MT103 with supporting documentation including contracts and delivery proofs.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency forwards to hedge FX exposures
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for volatile emerging market currencies
Cross-currency swaps for liquidity management across multiple currencies

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Modelo 200 - Impuesto sobre Sociedades)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 25 calendar days after the 6-month anniversary of fiscal year-end; calendar-year SL: 1-25 July of the following tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Voluntary late filing: surcharge of 5%-20% of the tax due plus late-payment interest; late filing after official request: fine EUR 1,500-EUR 60,000; understatement penalty up to 150% of the amount avoided; criminal referral for fraud above EUR 120,000

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Related-Party Transactions Informative Return (Modelo 232 - operaciones vinculadas) when aggregate related-party transactions exceed EUR 250,000 or involve tax-haven jurisdictions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same filing window as Modelo 200; calendar-year SL: 1-25 July of the following tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late informative return without prior request: EUR 200; after prior request: EUR 1,500; omitted or inaccurate data: EUR 150 per datum with minimum EUR 300; severe cases up to EUR 60,000

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts Deposit (Deposito de Cuentas Anuales) comprising balance sheet, profit and loss account, notes, audit report where applicable, and directors' report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial) and publication through Registro Mercantil Central
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Ordinary general meeting must approve accounts within 6 months of fiscal year-end; deposit must occur within 1 month of approval; calendar-year SL: approve by 30 June, deposit by 30 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry closure (cierre registral) preventing registration of any new corporate acts until deposit is made; pecuniary penalty of EUR 1,200 per year of delay under Article 378 Ley de Sociedades de Capital

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner Confirmation (Registro de Titulares Reales) filed with the Mercantile Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial under the AML framework of Law 10/2010 as amended by Royal Decree-Law 7/2021 and Law 11/2023
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrently with the annual accounts deposit (calendar-year SL: by 30 July); any UBO change must be updated within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: AML infringement fines from EUR 600 to EUR 60,000 for serious breaches; up to EUR 5,000,000 or 5% of net worth for very serious breaches; registry closure for persistent non-filing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Legalization of Statutory Books (Legalizacion de los Libros de los Empresarios) including journal, inventories, annual accounts book, and minutes book where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after fiscal year-end; calendar-year SL: before 30 April of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-legalized books lose evidentiary value in court; repeated failure may constitute an administrative offense with additional fines; company remains exposed to register audits

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT Summary Return (Modelo 390) - required only if the SL is not enrolled in the Immediate Supply of Information (SII) system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 30 January of the year following the tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharges plus late-payment interest; minimum fine EUR 300 when filed after formal request; fines up to EUR 60,000 for serious non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Withholding Information Returns (Modelo 190 for employment and professional income; Modelo 193 for movable capital income; Modelo 180 for urban rental income where applicable)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 January of the year following the tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of EUR 150 per omitted or incorrect datum with minimum EUR 300; late filing after official request: EUR 1,500-EUR 60,000

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit when the SL exceeds at least two of the three following thresholds on two consecutive fiscal years (Article 263 Ley de Sociedades de Capital): total assets above EUR 2,850,000; net turnover above EUR 5,700,000; average headcount above 50. Audit obligation applies from the following fiscal year; audit is also mandatory if the SL belongs to a group required to prepare consolidated accounts or if shareholders holding at least 5% of the capital request an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP (Plan General de Contabilidad approved by Real Decreto 1514/2007 as amended by Real Decreto 1/2021); SMEs may apply the PGC de Pymes if they meet the size limits; consolidation for listed groups uses EU-endorsed IFRS under Regulation (EC) 1606/2002.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SL must identify all natural persons directly or indirectly holding more than 25% of share capital or voting rights, or exercising control by other means, and must file a sworn statement with the Provincial Mercantile Registry. The statement is updated within 30 days of any UBO change and confirmed annually at the same time as the deposit of annual accounts. Where no natural-person UBO can be identified, senior managing directors are declared as the beneficial owners. The confirmation is included in the annual deposit filing without additional official fee beyond the registry tariff.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios) - mandatory for a Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada and kept at the registered office
Minutes Book (Libro de Actas) - covering both shareholders' general meetings and board meetings
Register of Contracts with the Sole Member (Libro Registro de Contratos con el Socio Unico) - required where the SL has a single shareholder

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $350 - $1,700 per year (EUR 300 - EUR 1,500) for professional domiciliation, registered office, corporate secretarial support, and statutory correspondence handling
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $6,000 - $32,000 per audit year (EUR 5,500 - EUR 30,000) for an auditor registered with the ICJCE/REGA; waived for an SL remaining below the compulsory audit thresholds

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard rate 25%; reduced to 23% for SMEs with annual turnover ≤ €50 million; 100% deduction for R&D expenditure; regional investment incentives; innovation patent regime

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 100 (Declaración del Impuesto sobre Sociedades) via AEAT e-Filing Portal (www.agenciatributaria.es)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 25 days after approval of annual accounts by the general meeting of shareholders (calendar year default 30 April)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A for Spanish resident SL; non-residents report through permanent establishment if applicable
Adjust for Spanish permanent establishment income and double taxation relief
Apply 25% rate to taxable base; claim any treaty relief

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: €100 per day (max €20,000); underpayment: 100% of tax due plus 3% annual interest; criminal sanctions possible for willful evasion

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Obtain TRC (Treaty Relief Certificate) from Spanish tax authorities via AEAT portal; submit supporting documentation including DTA and beneficial ownership certificate; WHT withheld at source or refunded post-approval
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 19% statutory; Interest: 19% statutory (reduced to 0% under most DTAs for related-party debt interest)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: €3,000,000 for local file; €50,000,000 for master file (OECD-aligned thresholds)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain implements EU Directive 2018/822 Economic Substance Regulations; entities must demonstrate adequate physical presence, core income-generating activities, and qualified employees for IP holding, financing, or distribution structures

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omitting taxable income or falsifying accounting records
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties: fines up to 5 times tax evaded, imprisonment up to 5 years, joint liability for directors
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal prosecution, disqualification from corporate offices, possible travel bans

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining Spanish SL without real business operations or substance requirements
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to €600,000; dissolution of company; back taxes plus 100% penalties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Joint and several liability for tax debts, possible imprisonment for fraudulent management, disqualification

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or maintain TP documentation or apply arm's length principle
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to 100% of tax adjustment; interest on underpayment; possible criminal liability
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines and disqualification; criminal sanctions for willful non-compliance

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to report cross-border payments or beneficial ownership
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to €1,000,000 or 2% of annual turnover; criminal sanctions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability, disqualification, possible imprisonment for fraudulent concealment
